provenance.change_from_0.1.1: Licensing-clean: the model reads no FTN charting data (CC BY-SA 4.0: QB blitz splits, defense blitz rate) and no nflverse participation data (man/zone coverage splits and rates; pressure, play-action, screen and box counts were already unused). charting_data=false blanks those play columns before any feature is built, and the blitz and coverage strengths are 0, so both factors are exactly 1.
provenance.evidence: Research Phase 2 ablation, test seasons 2023-25 (855 games, 11,060 player-games, 414,707 predictions), calibration fitted on 2021-22: log loss change vs 0.1.1 -0.00003 (95% interval -0.00007 to +0.00001), no measurable change in any market, season or position group.
provenance.remaining_sources: nflverse schedules, play-by-play, injuries, snap counts (from Pro Football Reference), weekly rosters, depth charts: listed as CC-BY 4.0 by nflverse (credit nflverse). See modelroom/sources/registry.py.
